profile_text.body:
Google is a public company founded in 1998 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, traded on public markets under the ticker GOOGL. Its own website, focused on the Gemini product, describes Gemini as Google's AI assistant, offering help with writing, planning, and brainstorming, and positioning it as an experience in generative AI. The company reported revenue of $402,836,000,000 for the period ending 2025-12-31, as filed in a 10-K with the SEC under CIK 0001652044.

Google's tracked AI product portfolio spans several categories. Gemini is its general large language model assistant, while Google AI Studio serves as a model prototyping environment for developers. NotebookLM is a document-grounded tool that ingests uploaded corpora, and Google Drive AI and Google Meet AI bring Gemini integration into its Workspace suite for storage, sharing, meeting summaries, and live captions. On the healthcare side, Google Med-PaLM and MedLM are described as medical large language models focused on clinical reasoning and healthcare data, with a HIPAA BAA noted as required. TensorFlow and Keras round out the portfolio as open-source machine learning frameworks, with TensorFlow Extended supporting MLOps workflows.

The held facts record 161 legal matters with California exposure but list no specific named cases. Google's services appear across ten third-party MCP servers in the registry, covering Google Ads campaign management and automation, Google News search, Google Search Console reporting, Google Forms, Google Calendar scheduling, and Google Trends interest tracking, all built by external developers connecting to Google's platforms.
